items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And it was on many occasions when John Hammond really made efforts to try to get friendship, regain

ctx.x: I mean, why did he get Prez fired, then?

It seems that Prez wanted $125, and he told Basie that he wasn't worth it, or something like that. The way Prez used to tell me, -- as I said before, as close as Prez and I were, and I was the best man at his wedding and like the father of his children there for a long time, he used to tell me these things. And it was on many occasions when John Hammond really made efforts to try to get friendship, regain
his friendship. He never did, never did.
